Interface Bound

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClusteredNioDavHandler, CodecDuplexHandler, CodecRequestHandler, DavHandler, DuplexHandler, GrpcBidiStreaming, GrpcClientStreaming, GrpcHandler, GrpcServerStreaming, GrpcUnary, Handler, JacksonCodec, Json, Json, JsonHandler, JsonHandler, NdjsonHandler, NioDavHandler, OAuthServer, Oidc, Protobuf, ProtobufHandler, RequestHandler, Security, SseHandler, StandaloneNioDavHandler, StaticFiles, ViewHandler, WebSocketHandler, Xml, XmlHandler
public interface Bound
A framework seam, not an application API: something the app did not build through its constructor gets the app's services here, once, at start. A handler base whose type arguments name what it needs (CodecRequestHandler), or a service a module added already built (a codec wrapping a configured mapper) and that looks up an optional collaborator. Applications take services through their constructor.
